**Reviewer Name:** [Full Name]

---

## 1️⃣ Project Goal & Motivation

**Describe the goal of the project in your own words.**  
What real-world question is the team trying to answer, and why does it matter?

> _Your response here_

---

## 2️⃣ Dataset Description

**Describe the dataset being used.**

- Which TidyTuesday week?
- What type of data is it (health, economics, environment, etc.)?
- What is the unit of analysis (person, country, event, etc.)?

> _Your response here_

---

## 3️⃣ Modeling & Methods Plan

**Describe how the research questions will be answered.**

Indicate which of the following are clearly planned:

- [ ] Regression  
- [ ] Classification  
- [ ] Clustering  

What are the proposed targets, features, or grouping structures?

> _Your response here_

---

## 4️⃣ Clarity & Scope Check

**Is anything unclear, overly vague, or too ambitious for the project timeline?**

- Are the research questions well-defined?
- Is the modeling scope reasonable?
- Are any key details missing?

> _Your response here_

---

## 5️⃣ Constructive Feedback for Improvement

**Provide specific, actionable suggestions for strengthening the project.**

This may include:

- Narrowing or refining the research question
- Improving feature selection ideas
- Adding or removing a modeling approach
- Refining ethical framing

> _Your response here_

---

## 6️⃣ Most Compelling Aspect

**What part of this project are you most excited to see developed and presented?**

> _Your response here_

---

## 7️⃣ File & Code Organization Feedback

**Does the proposed project structure align with professional standards?**

Consider:

- Separation of `ds.py`, `test_ds.py`, notebook, and report
- Reproducibility
- Clarity of responsibilities between files

> _Your response here_

---

## 8️⃣ Ethical & Societal Considerations

**Does the proposal meaningfully address ethical risks, bias, or societal impact?**

- Who could be harmed by misuse?
- Who might benefit most from the analysis?
- Are there missing ethical considerations?

> _Your response here_

---

## 9️⃣ Optional Additional Feedback

Any other comments, concerns, or suggestions?

> _Your response here_

---

✅ **Reminder:**  
Your role as a reviewer is to help strengthen the project through **constructive, professional, and specific feedback**. Avoid vague praise or generic criticism. Focus on clarity, feasibility, rigor, and responsibility.
